text:
alex.k: FYI — creating thread for follow-up on yesterday's noisy paging during fallback. Need runbook and commander rotation updates so this doesn't happen again.

maria: TL;DR: metrics spike tripped SLO and rate-limit alerts, autoscaler hit burst cap, automatic fallback to quantized-variant-v2 introduced higher latency and client retry churn. Impact: subset of enterprise tenants observed +5-15s p95 and ~0.3% error increase for ~22 minutes.

santosh: missed most of it, can you post timeline?

maria: timeline (approx):
- 14:02 alert: api.cluster.serve.p95 high
- 14:03 autoscaler DCx returned burst limit reached
- 14:04 automatic fallback -> quantized-variant-v2
- 14:05 429/retry spike from client side
- 14:24 stabilized after manual scale and config tweak

jen: oncall notes: autoscaler used burst-policy=conservative which throttled node add. We flipped to burst-policy=aggressive at 14:08. Also found a few stuck KV shards, cleared them.

ops-bot: INCIDENT-1804126700 status: resolved. Duration: 22m. Severity: sv2. Participants: maria, alex.k, jen, santosh, kevin, ops-bot.

kevin: root problem: fallback path wasn't validated against our retry/backoff defaults. We should require a verification step before enabling auto-fallback. Also add load tests for fallback variants.

alex.k: proposed immediate runbook edits: 1) add "Fallback verification" checklist under Model Fallback; 2) require commander to nominate a Shadow Commander for 30m when fallback happens; 3) add escalation to Eng-Platform if autoscaler fails to allocate extra capacity within 5m.

maria: +1 on shadow commander. Also add an explicit manual scale command to playbook for oncall: `rictl scale --pool <pool> --nodes +2 --reason \"incident-manual-burst\"`. Put it in the troubleshooting steps.

santosh: I have the KV-clear snippet I ran yesterday, can include in playbook:
```
# clear stale KV shards
for shard in $(rictl kv list --stale); do
  rictl kv clear --shard $shard || echo "clear failed $shard"
done
```
We should specify when it's safe to run this.

jen: I'll draft the runbook PR. Also update on-call handoff checklist to surface "recent fallback events" so incoming night crews know if anything triggered in last 24h.

alex.k: handoff checklist addition: checkbox: "note any fallback triggers in last 24h + model variants involved + current autoscaler policy".

kevin: action: add CI load-test for quantized-variant-v2 (owner: kevin, due: 2025-01-10). Include synthetic clients that exercise retry patterns.

maria: acceptance criteria for load-test: p95 < 250ms at sustained 50 qps; no retry-induced 429 cascade during a 30m run.

jen: scheduling postmortem meeting: proposed 2025-01-07 10:00am PT, 30m. Agenda: timeline, root cause, mitigations, runbook changes, test plan. Anyone object?

kevin: fine.

ops-bot: calendar-event-created: Postmortem: INCIDENT-1804126700 — 2025-01-07 10:00am PT. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/incident-1804126700

maria: I'll bring metrics (p95, error rate, node counts, autoscaler logs) and scrubbed customer impact notes.

alex.k: wording change proposal for commander rotation in playbook:
```
- Commander: remain on-call for 60m after takeover
+ Commander: remain on-call for 60m after takeover. If a model fallback is triggered while commander is active, commander must nominate a Shadow Commander for 30m overlap to aid rollback and coordination.
```
Make nomination explicit.

santosh: small UX improvement: add a quick-link in the incident template to the autoscaler dashboard and prefilled `rictl scale` CLI invocation for the pool. Saves time during paging.

alex.k: also add a quick check in runbook to compare client retry/backoff defaults (currently 3 retries, 250ms base) to fallback tail latency and document thresholds that should block auto-fallback.

kevin: opening load-test PR today and will tag @maria for acceptance criteria.

maria: copy — will validate when CI runs.

jen: follow-up tracker card created: https://tracker.example.com/issue/RED-1123; i'll link the PRs and attach the KV script.

alex.k: action summary: PR for runbook (jen) due 2025-01-05; KV script + test (santosh) due 2025-01-06; load-tests + PR (kevin) due 2025-01-10; postmortem meeting 2025-01-07 10:00am PT; oncall handoff update included in runbook PR.

maria: tagging this for ops retro so leadership can see fallback trend. Thanks all, please update tracker as items land.

ops-bot: INCIDENT-1804126700 status: postmortem scheduled. Postmortem doc: https://docs.example.com/incidents/1804126700

alex.k: will follow up after runbook PR merge to confirm final wording and close the loop. :thumbsup:
